- [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable) — Python test runner with fixtures, parametrization and an extensible plugin ecosystem.
- [pytest-cov](https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest-cov) — pytest plugin for measuring Python test coverage through coverage.py, including optional distributed-test integration.
- [Qdrant](https://qdrant.tech/) — Vector database and similarity-search engine available for self-hosted and managed deployments.
- [Quay](https://quay.io) — Container registry for building, storing, and distributing images.
- [Rakazo](https://rakazo.com/) — Self-hosted agent workspace with sandboxed browser and shell sessions, routines, approvals, and audit history.
- [Ray](https://www.ray.io/) — Apache-licensed distributed computing framework and AI compute engine for scaling Python and machine-learning workloads.
- [Red Hat OpenShift Pipelines](https://www.redhat.com/en/technologies/cloud-computing/openshift/pipelines) — Red Hat-supported, Operator-delivered CI/CD distribution for OpenShift built from Tekton components and included with an OpenShift subscription.
- [reShapr](https://reshapr.io) — No-code MCP server that translates existing REST, GraphQL, and gRPC APIs into MCP endpoints with security controls and flexible deployment (Apache-2.0).
- [Review Flow](https://dgouron.github.io/review-flow) — GitHub pull request review workflow visualization and management tool.
- [Sauce Labs Real Device Cloud](https://saucelabs.com/platform/real-device-cloud) — Mobile app testing on a wide range of real devices.
- [sbt](https://www.scala-sbt.org) — Interactive build tool for Scala, Java, and other JVM projects.
- [Scalr](https://github.com/Scalr) — Terraform automation and collaboration software.
- [sccache](https://github.com/mozilla/sccache) — Compiler cache supporting local and remote storage backends.
- [Schemathesis](https://schemathesis.readthedocs.io/en/stable/) — Property-based API testing tool that generates cases from OpenAPI and GraphQL schemas.
- [Score](https://score.dev) — Score is a platform-agnostic container workload specification expressed in score.yaml; separate implementations such as score-compose and score-k8s translate it into platform configuration. The specification repository is not a Kubernetes deployment platform.
- [Selenium](https://www.selenium.dev) — Browser WebDriver automation and Selenium Grid ecosystem for cross-browser application testing.
- [Semantic Pull Request (GitHub Action)](https://github.com/amannn/action-semantic-pull-request) — GitHub Action validating pull request titles against Conventional Commits naming conventions.
- [Semaphore CI](https://semaphore.io/) — Semaphore CI/CD product family with hosted Cloud, self-hosted Apache-2.0 Community code outside ee/, and a separately licensed commercial Enterprise edition.
- [ServerSpec](https://serverspec.org) — Ruby/RSpec-based server-state assertions for installed packages, services, ports and configuration.
- [Shipwright](https://shipwright.io) — Kubernetes-native image-build orchestration using Build and BuildRun resources and pluggable build strategies backed by Tekton.
- [Sim](https://www.sim.ai) — AI workspace for building, deploying, and monitoring agentic workflows.
- [simple-git-hooks](https://github.com/toplenboren/simple-git-hooks) — Minimal Node.js Git hooks manager using package.json or local configuration, with one command per hook.
- [Skaffold](https://skaffold.dev) — Client-side container-development CLI for build, test, push, deploy and debug loops with Kubernetes and other supported targets; upstream plans repository archival on 29 January 2027.
- [Skopeo](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo) — Daemonless tool to inspect, copy and synchronize remote OCI/container images and registries without building or running images.
- [Spin](https://spinframework.dev) — Framework for building and running serverless WebAssembly applications.
- [Stakpak](https://stakpak.dev) — Autonomous AI agent for production operations running 24/7 on your machines to auto-heal incidents, manage costs, and monitor infrastructure (Apache-2.0).
- [Stategraph Orchestration (formerly Terrateam)](https://stategraph.com) — Stategraph Orchestration, formerly Terrateam, automates Terraform/OpenTofu plans and applies through GitHub or GitLab pull requests and CI runners. Its MPL-2.0 open-source core is distinct from commercial Enterprise, hosted services and Stategraph Infrastructure as a Database.
- [StepSecurity](https://www.stepsecurity.io/) — Commercial software supply-chain security platform for GitHub Actions policy, remediation, and runner runtime protection.
- [Syft](https://oss.anchore.com/docs/guides/sbom/) — Anchore open-source CLI and Go library generating SBOMs from container images, filesystems and supported archives in formats including SPDX and CycloneDX; Grype scanning and Anchore Enterprise are separate.
- [TeamCity](https://www.jetbrains.com/teamcity) — JetBrains commercial CI/CD product offered as TeamCity On-Premises and TeamCity Cloud.
- [Tekton](https://tekton.dev) — Kubernetes-native CI/CD framework and ecosystem built around Tekton Pipelines, with complementary triggers, tooling and supply-chain components.
- [Tekton Chains](https://tekton.dev/docs/chains/) — Tekton controller that records, signs, and stores supply-chain metadata for pipeline task runs.
- [Terraform MCP Server](https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-mcp-server) — HashiCorp MCP server for Terraform Registry discovery and authenticated HCP Terraform/Terraform Enterprise workspace and run workflows.
- [terraform-aws-eks-operation-scheduler](https://github.com/gianniskt/terraform-aws-eks-operation-scheduler) — Terraform module that schedules AWS EKS node groups to scale up and down with Lambda and EventBridge for cost savings.
- [terraform-docs](https://terraform-docs.io) — CLI and library generating Terraform module documentation from module configuration in multiple formats, with CI and pre-commit integration; it does not execute infrastructure or generate provider reference documentation.
- [terraform-plugin-docs](https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-docs) — HashiCorp tfplugindocs CLI and packages generate, migrate and validate Terraform provider/plugin documentation using examples, templates and provider schema; distinct from terraform-docs for modules.
- [terraform-skill](https://github.com/antonbabenko/terraform-skill) — Claude Code skill for Terraform and OpenTofu best practices, testing, modules, CI/CD, and security.
- [Terragrunt](https://terragrunt.com/) — Gruntwork open-source orchestration CLI for scaling OpenTofu and Terraform infrastructure with reusable configuration, units and dependencies.
- [terravision](https://github.com/patrickchugh/terravision) — Generate professional cloud architecture diagrams automatically from Terraform code (AWS, Google, Azure).
- [Test Kitchen](https://kitchen.ci) — Ruby integration testing framework that provisions and verifies infrastructure code on isolated test targets.
- [Testcontainers](https://github.com/testcontainers) — Multi-language libraries for integration testing with disposable containers; language libraries and paid cloud offerings have separate licences.
- [Testkube](https://testkube.io) — Kubernetes-native test orchestration product with a standalone public agent, mixed MIT and Testkube Community License code, and a commercial control plane.
- [TestRail](https://www.gurock.com/testrail) — Test case management platform.
- [TestRigor](https://testrigor.com) — AI-powered end-to-end testing platform.
- [The Update Framework](https://theupdateframework.io/) — CNCF framework and specification for securing software update metadata against repository and signing-key compromise.
- [To Be Continuous](https://to-be-continuous.gitlab.io/doc) — Modular GitLab CI template ecosystem for standardizing and accelerating professional pipelines.
- [Travis CI](https://www.travis-ci.com) — CI/CD service for GitHub.
- [Trunk](https://trunk.io/) — Developer workflow platform for code checks, flaky-test management, and merge automation.
- [Upjet](https://github.com/crossplane/upjet) — Code generation and controller runtime for building Crossplane providers from Terraform providers.
- [validate-dependabot](https://github.com/marocchino/validate-dependabot) — GitHub Action that validates `dependabot.yml` against the official Dependabot schema before merge.
- [Vercel](https://vercel.com/) — Managed web application platform providing Git-based builds, preview deployments, production hosting, and serverless infrastructure.
- [VictoriaMetrics MCP server](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/mcp-victoriametrics) — Model Context Protocol server that exposes VictoriaMetrics observability operations to compatible AI clients.
- [Vitest](https://vitest.dev) — Vite-native JavaScript and TypeScript test runner with component, watch and optional browser testing modes.
- [VoltAgent](https://voltagent.dev) — Open-source TypeScript framework for building AI agents.
- [webpack](https://webpack.js.org/) — JavaScript module bundler with code splitting and a plugin-based build pipeline.
- [werf](https://werf.io) — Git-driven Kubernetes delivery tool combining container-image builds, deployment and Helm-based release workflows.
- [Woodpecker CI](https://woodpecker-ci.org) — Apache-2.0 self-hosted CI/CD engine with a server and agents, forge integration and backend-dependent Docker, Kubernetes or local execution.
- [Xray](https://www.getxray.app) — Test management for Jira (manual + automated tests).
- [Yarn](https://yarnpkg.com/) — JavaScript package manager with lockfiles, workspaces, and configurable dependency-installation modes.
